sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The RB-MP11 key (RB-MP11) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to one of the Federal State Reserve Agency base Service and Repair Center workshop rooms.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In the Common fund stash (Shturman's crate)
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Customs
sections.text: - In the shipping yard container building. On the desk with the papers.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Unlocks a door on the second story of black knight on Reserve

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- One Jacket
- One Toolbox
- Intelligence folder spawns on the desks
